## Requirement

<a id="Migrated"></a>

### What a shipment stores migrates

`Migrated` · `src/obligations.ts:25` · status: **held**

Each entity the shipment reaches (what its programs store or read, kept outside the graph) is to prove: every version of its description deployed so far migrates to the one shipped, each step decided. A family of obligations: a policy applies it, and the entity's own status says whether it holds.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ kinds }) => (sketch: GraphSketch, reach: ObligationReach): ObligationFinding => ({
    obliged: sketch.nodes.filter((n) => (kinds as readonly string[]).includes(n.kind) && reach.reached.includes(n.ref)).map((n) => ({ node: n.ref, via: n.ref })),
    gaps: [],
  })
```

</details>

- Owner: trame
- Parameters: `kinds` ← [The kinds the library carries](#DataKinds)
- Refines: [Data described once](product.md#DataDescribedOnce)
- Applies: [An entity is described once](principles.md#DescribedOnce)
